# Expected cross-file edges for the Rust fixture: kind<TAB>from<TAB>to.
# `Defines` and same-file edges are not listed (always same-file).
# A leading `?` marks an edge that is allowed but not required: a
# documented limit of name-based resolution, neither a miss nor a hit.
# Abbreviations used in the comments: M = alpha main.rs, E = engine/mod.rs,
# P = engine/parts.rs, L = beta-core lib.rs, U = util.rs, O = observe.rs,
# W = shapes/widget.rs, G = shapes/gadget.rs.

# ── alpha/src/main.rs ──
# `extern crate beta_core;` → the crate root.
Imports	crates/alpha/src/main.rs	crates/beta-core/src/lib.rs
Imports	crates/alpha/src/main.rs	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/widget.rs
# `use beta_core::util::{self, helper as h};` → the util module (self + helper).
Imports	crates/alpha/src/main.rs	crates/beta-core/src/util.rs
# `use beta_core::Gadget;` is a `pub use` re-export in lib.rs; followed to the definition.
Imports	crates/alpha/src/main.rs	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/gadget.rs
# `use engine::*;` → the child module's file.
Imports	crates/alpha/src/main.rs	crates/alpha/src/engine/mod.rs
# h() (alias), util::only_here() (module via `self`), beta_core::util::helper() (absolute).
Calls	crates/alpha/src/main.rs	crates/beta-core/src/util.rs
# Widget::new() (type owner), w.spin() (method defined only on Widget),
# w.describe(): `describe` is a method of both imported types, but
# `let w = Widget::new()` types the receiver (receiver typing), so only
# Widget's file is linked.
Calls	crates/alpha/src/main.rs	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/widget.rs
# Gadget::new() through the re-export.
Calls	crates/alpha/src/main.rs	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/gadget.rs
# run_engine() through the glob import.
Calls	crates/alpha/src/main.rs	crates/alpha/src/engine/mod.rs
# std::cmp::max and local() produce no edge.

# ── alpha/src/engine/mod.rs ──
Imports	crates/alpha/src/engine/mod.rs	crates/alpha/src/engine/parts.rs
# Part::new(), p.tick(), crate::engine::parts::assemble().
Calls	crates/alpha/src/engine/mod.rs	crates/alpha/src/engine/parts.rs

# ── alpha/src/engine/parts.rs ──
Imports	crates/alpha/src/engine/parts.rs	crates/beta-core/src/observe.rs
Implements	crates/alpha/src/engine/parts.rs	crates/beta-core/src/observe.rs
# o.notify() on `dyn Observer`: the trait's file, not the impls (G, P).
Calls	crates/alpha/src/engine/parts.rs	crates/beta-core/src/observe.rs

# ── beta-core/src/shapes/gadget.rs ──
# `use super::widget::Widget;`
Imports	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/gadget.rs	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/widget.rs
Imports	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/gadget.rs	crates/beta-core/src/observe.rs
Calls	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/gadget.rs	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/widget.rs
Implements	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/gadget.rs	crates/beta-core/src/observe.rs

# ── beta-core/src/lib.rs ──
# `pub use shapes::gadget::Gadget;`
Imports	crates/beta-core/src/lib.rs	crates/beta-core/src/shapes/gadget.rs

# observe.rs: o.notify() resolves to the trait in the same file (no edge).
# util.rs, widget.rs, shapes/mod.rs: no references.
